page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.s3 family. It features 4 dedicated physical cores with 4 vCPUs, meaning hyperthreading is not active with 1.0 thread per core. The instance is allocated 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. There are zero GPUs integrated into this instance, and it does not come with any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is structured for compute-heavy tasks that do not demand large memory footprints. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. It is suitable for workloads such as web serving, lightweight application servers, batch processing, and distributed microservices that require dedicated CPU resources but have modest memory requirements.
